title: Engenheiro de Software Pleno PJ (Ruby on Rails)
description:
O Grupo Smart Fit é muito mais do que a maior rede de academias da América Latina e o maior empregador de profissionais de educação física do mundo. Somos um verdadeiro ecossistema focado em bem-estar e saúde, impactando a vida de milhares de pessoas todos os dias.

Estamos em mais de 15 países, com mais de 1.800 unidades, e temos o prazer de atender mais de 5,2 milhões de alunos. Nossa equipe de 15 mil colaboradores está sempre a mil, trazendo novas ideias e inovações. Desde que abrimos nossa capital em 2021, aceleramos nossa missão de transformar vidas com soluções de fitness e saúde.

Temos várias marcas no nosso portfólio, como Bio Ritmo, Smart Fit, Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, One Pilates, Velocity, Kore TotalPass e Nation CT. Além disso, oferecemos produtos digitais como Queima Diária, Smart Fit Nutri e Smart Fit Coach. Estamos sempre procurando novas formas de integrar tecnologia e inovação para ajudar você a ter um estilo de vida mais ativo e saudável. E aí, topa o desafio junto com a gente?

O que nos move todos os dias?

Somos parte da mudança, transformando o cenário e trazendo mais qualidade para a vida de quem tá junto com a gente. Cada gotinha de suor é uma prova do nosso compromisso em inspirar e motivar todo mundo que quer uma vida mais ativa e saudável. A cada dia, começamos nossa jornada com aquecimento total, prontos para alcançar novos objetivos e viver o máximo.

O Engenheiro de Software Pleno PJ (Ruby on Rails) será responsável por:

1. Desenvolvimento e Entrega Técnica

  • Construção da API Core: Desenvolver e manter endpoints RESTful eficientes utilizando Ruby on Rails para suportar as aplicações Web e Mobile.
  • Escrita de Testes Automatizados: Garantir a estabilidade do sistema através de testes de integração e unitários (RSpec), utilizando VCR e WebMock para garantir que as dependências externas não atrasem o pipeline.
  • Otimização de Performance: Garantir que a API seja rápida e escalável, aplicando boas práticas de banco de dados (PostgreSQL) e evitando gargalos de processamento.

2. Integração e Homologação (Foco em Qualidade)

  • Validação de Integração: Testar e homologar ativamente as interações da API com o desenvolvimento Front-end (Web e Mobile), garantindo que os dados trafegados estejam corretos e performáticos.
  • Garantia de Eficiência: Assegurar a máxima qualidade no processo de integração, antecipando falhas de contrato de dados e garantindo que as funcionalidades atendam aos requisitos de UI/UX de ambos os clientes.
  • Definição de Contratos: Colaborar no desenho técnico prévio dos endpoints para garantir que o time de Front-end tenha mocks funcionais e especificações claras, minimizando o retrabalho.

3. Colaboração e Alinhamento

  • Gestão de Bloqueios: Atuar de forma proativa para identificar e comunicar impedimentos técnicos que possam impactar o cronograma de 3 meses.
  • Code Review: Participar de revisões de código focadas em manter o padrão de qualidade da equipe e a consistência do "Rails Way".

4. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua

  • Evolução Profissional: Manter-se atualizado com as novas versões do Ruby e do Rails, trazendo as melhores práticas de segurança e arquitetura para o projeto a longo prazo.
  • Aprimoramento de Processos: Analisar constantemente o ciclo de desenvolvimento e propor melhorias que tornem o fluxo de deploy e a integração com o front-end mais ágeis.

5. Documentação e Sustentabilidade

  • Documentação Técnica: Manter uma documentação clara e atualizada da API (ex: Swagger/OpenAPI) para servir como fonte única de verdade para os times de consumo.
  • Manutenibilidade: Equilibrar o pragmatismo da entrega rápida com a saúde do código, garantindo uma base sólida para a evolução permanente do produto.

Itens essenciais que não podem faltar no seu kit:

  • Ruby on Rails (Modo API): Domínio profundo do framework, priorizando o "Rails Way" e o uso de scaffolding eficiente para velocidade de entrega.
  • Design de API RESTful: Experiência em estruturar endpoints que atendam simultaneamente Web e Mobile (JSON, paginação, versionamento).
  • Testes e Mocking (RSpec): Domínio de VCR e WebMock para simular interações externas de forma determinística, garantindo uma suíte de testes rápida e confiável.
  • Modelagem de Dados: Experiência com PostgreSQL e uso eficiente de Active Record (evitando o problema de N+1).
  • Autenticação e Segurança: Implementação prática de JWT ou Devise Token Auth.
  • Pragmatismo e Foco: Foco em resolver o problema de negócio com a solução mais simples e direta, evitando "overengineering".
  • Comunicação Proativa e Colaboração: Habilidade de alinhar contratos de API antecipadamente com os times de Front-end e Mobile para evitar bloqueios e garantir que a integração seja fluida.
  • Antecipação de Riscos (Atitude Dono): Capacidade de identificar gargalos ou requisitos ambíguos precocemente, levantando a mão e propondo soluções para evitar retrabalhos.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Mentalidade colaborativa, compartilhando conhecimento e garantindo que o código seja legível e mantível para o restante do time.
  • Autonomia: Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas alinhadas às convenções do Rails sem necessidade de microgerenciamento.

Diferencial (IA): Uso de ferramentas como GitHub Copilot ou Cursor para acelerar a escrita de código e geração de mocks de dados.

Founded in 1895 in Austria, the company designs, manufactures and sells the world's finest crystal, gemstones, Swarovski Created Diamonds and zirconia, jewelry, and accessories, as well as crystal objects and home accessories. Swarovski Crystal Business has a global reach with approximately 2,400 stores and 6,700 points of sales in around 140 countries and employs more than 18,000 people. Together with its sister companies Swarovski Optik (optical devices) and Tyrolit (abrasives), Swarovski Crystal Business forms the Swarovski Group. title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
About WSO2

Founded in 2005, WSO2 is the largest independent software vendor providing open-source API management, integration, and identity and access management (IAM) products. WSO2's products and platforms—including our next-gen internal developer platform, Choreo—empower organizations to leverage the full potential of APIs for secure delivery of digital services and applications, enabling thousands of enterprises in over 90 countries globally to drive their digital transformation journeys. Our open-source, API-first approach frees developers and architects from vendor lock-in, enabling rapid digital product creation. Recognized as leaders by industry analysts, WSO2 has over 800 employees worldwide with offices in Australia, Brazil, Germany, India, Sri Lanka, the UAE, the UK, and the US, with nearly USD100M in annual recurring revenue. Visit to learn more. Follow WSO2 on LinkedIn and X (formerly Twitter).

About the Role

As a Site Reliability Engineer at WSO2, you'll be instrumental in both supporting our existing customers with their managed or private cloud deployments and initiating new deployments across leading cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, and GCP. Your mission will include ensuring the seamless operation, scalability, and security of WSO2 cloud services, alongside automating processes to boost both efficiency and reliability.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Deployment Setup and Management:
  • Lead the design and implementation of new cloud deployments, tailoring solutions to meet stakeholder requirements on platforms like Azure, AWS, GCP, and Kubernetes.
  • Optimize cloud architectures for scalability and cost-effectiveness, adhering to best practices for networking, security, and access controls.
  • Gain and maintain deep knowledge of cloud infrastructure providers to create robust solutions.
  • Automation and CI/CD:
  • Craft and manage automation scripts and infrastructure as code (IaC) with Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation.
  • Deploy CI/CD pipelines to streamline software delivery, testing, and deployment processes, ensuring efficient version control and configuration management.
  • Managed Cloud Support:
  • Ensure the availability of the services by configuring system monitors and alerts and attending to critical alerts in a timely manner.
  • Offer continuous support and maintenance for existing deployments, monitoring system performance and swiftly resolving issues to maintain high availability and reliability.
  • Implement strategies for performance optimization and failure prevention, conducting thorough root cause analyses to avoid future issues.
  • Monitoring and Security:
  • Establish comprehensive monitoring and alerting systems to oversee customer deployments, setting thresholds for incident response.
  • Conduct regular security assessments and stay abreast of the latest threats and trends to fortify cloud environments against risks.
  • Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing:
  • Foster a collaborative environment with product developers, operations, and QA teams to enhance workflows and product quality.
  • Share knowledge and best practices, contributing to the team’s collective expertise through documentation, training, and mentorship.

Skills and Experience

  • Fluent in English.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Expertise in cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS and GCP.
  • Expertise in Linux, virtualization and containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • A solid understanding of networking, security principles, and compliance frameworks.
  • Proficiency in IaC tools (Terraform, CloudFormation), configuration management (Puppet, Chef, Helm), and scripting languages (Python, Bash, PowerShell).
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (Github Actions, Jenkins) and monitoring/logging tools (Prometheus, ELK stack, Splunk).
  • Exceptional problem-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills, coupled with a proactive, customer-centric mindset.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.

In Addition to a Competitive Compensation Package, WSO2 Offers:

  • A work culture and environment where we value both hard work AND flexibility.
  • A flexible vacation/leave plan that fits your needs.
  • Health, dental, and life insurance for you and your family.

Diversity Drives Innovation:

We've built our business on a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We believe it's important to foster an environment that values and respects each individual's strengths, perspectives, and ideas. Doing so not only drives innovation; it also ensures that we can create superior experiences for our customers, partners, and employees worldwide. We value the diversity of our team regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, or veteran or marital status, and we do not tolerate any form of discrimination.

title: New Product Evaluation leader - QUALITY
description:
Job Purpose:

The New Product Evaluation analyst is responsible for ensuring the quality, functionality, and compliance of new products and product transfer projects. This role plays a key part in planning and executing test protocols, managing quality issues, and converting customer and regulatory requirements into actionable quality standards.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate new products and transfer projects to ensure they meet performance, quality, and compliance standards.
  • Develop and organize validation protocols, test plans, and quality checklists.
  • Identify, document, and manage quality issues through a closed-loop process, including root cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions (CAPA).
  • Translate customer, regulatory, and internal quality requirements into clear, actionable criteria for development and manufacturing teams.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain during product development and transfer.
  • Participate in pilot runs and provide quality feedback to optimize processes before mass production.
  • Maintain accurate records of test results, reports, and technical documentation.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, or a related technical field.
  • Solid knowledge and experience in quality management; hands-on experience in new product evaluation is strongly preferred.
  • Strong analytical and data interpretation skills; proficient in Excel and quality tools such as Six Sigma, SPC, QC methods, etc.
  • Effective communicator with strong organizational and stress management skills.
  • Fluent in English; proficiency in Portuguese and Chinese is a plus.
  • Customer-oriented, results-driven, resilient, and committed to integrity and continuous improvement.

工作内容：

  1. 负责新品及转产项目评价；
  2. 负责新品及转产项目测试项目制定及组织开展测试；
  3. 负责新品及转产项目问题闭环管理；
  4. 负责新品及转产项目品质要求转化。

任职资格

  1. 具备相关的学术背景和专业知识；
  2. 1-3年以上质量管理工作经验，从事过新品评价等相关工作经验优先；

title: Corporate Legal - Associate
description:
About the Company

Credit Saison Brazil (“CSBR”) is part of Credit Saison Group, which has Credit Saison Co. Ltd. (Japan) as ultimate parent and Saison International (Singapore) as its international headquarter. Our core businesses are lending operation and equity investment consisting of early-stage start-up investment and M&A/joint venture.

Founded in 1951, Credit Saison Co. Ltd., is one of Japan’s largest non-bank financial corporations listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Outside Japan, over 1,000 talented employees are working across global markets because of Credit Saison's dedication to foster an environment of diversity, collaboration, inclusion and career growth. The group has a mission to bring people, partners and technology together, delivering resilient and innovative financial solutions for positive impact.

Established in 2023, CSBR primarily provides credit solutions in Brazilian private debt market to support the innovators as a transformative partner in contributing to financial inclusion. So, if you're passionate about making positive impacts in the finance sector while working in a multi-cultural environment, we want to hear from you. Join us on this exciting journey, where your talent can make a meaningful difference and together, let's contribute to the future of finance in Brazil.

About the Role

  • Prepare drafts, review and independently negotiate documents of different areas and variable complexity (such as NDAs, service agreement, engagement letters, software related agreements, employment agreements, head-hunter agreements, lease agreements) ensuring compliance with legal framework, identifying potential risks and providing acceptable mitigation suggestions in a timely manner.
  • Analyze, organize and align comments and changes in contracts reviews with external counsels, key internal and international stakeholders, including the Global Legal & Compliance.
  • Conduct legal research on relevant regulations and case law to support decision making, ensuring contract terms and corporate alignment with latest legal developments and internal policies.
  • Provide, jointly with the corporate legal team, tailored legal advice across multiple areas such as corporate governance, labor, tax, civil law and regulatory (including Central Bank matters), ensuring strategic alignment with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
  • Draft, review and coordinate the execution of corporate resolutions, ensuring that all legally and governance-required elements are accurately reflected in the minutes, while also managing with third party service providers, under the Corporate Legal Manager’s supervision: (i) submissions to the Central Bank and registrations with the Board of Trade; and (ii) registration of the minutes in corporate books, in accordance with local corporate regulation.
  • Enhancing internal legal processes, developing standardized templates and implementing best practices to increase efficiency in both legal analysis and compliance.
  • Lead, under the Corporate Legal’s Manager supervision, specific projects related to license application to Central Bank, compliance with LGPD (Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados), corporate and tax structuring initiatives.
  • Coordinating cross-functional legal initiatives, preparing materials, improving reporting structures and weekly routines with stakeholders;
  • Coordinate requests for documents to international stakeholders, receipt, translation, notarization and registry with local external counsels and paralegals, in accordance with local regulations.
  • Support the Corporate Legal team by establishing routines to monitor legal updates, sharing relevant information with key stakeholders, assessing potential impacts on the company’s business, and proposing and implementing appropriate solutions.
  • Support knowledge sharing and internal development initiatives through the preparation of materials or participation in training activities

Requirements

  • 6 - 7 years of post-qualification experience as a Lawyer (preferably some experience working as in-house counsel), strong general profile, desirable experience with corporate, civil, labor and regulatory (Central Bank) law;
  • Bachelor's degree in law;
  • Duly registered with the Brazilian Bar Association (OAB);
  • Strong ability to manage priorities;
  • Good organization and proactive profile;
  • Clear and objective communication skills for interaction with diverse internal and external stakeholders;
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken);
  • Excellent legal technical skills and strong attention to detail;
  • Solid interpersonal and collaborative abilities.

title: Senior Instrumentation Engineer - (Relocation to Saudi Arabia is required)
description:
Role : Senior Instrumentation Engineer

Job Description:

We are seeking an Instrumentation Engineer with extensive experience in Instrumentation utilized for the final control, monitoring and safety of Gas Plants, NGL Fractionation Plants, Refineries, petrochemicals plants, Pipelines and Distribution facilities, to join the Process Automation and Systems Division, which is part of the Process & Control Systems Department.

Process and Control Systems Department provides services in the field of process engineering, automation, new energy, and digitalization to various entities within Aramco.

As an Instrumentation Engineer your primary role will be to provide instrumentation engineering expertise to the various Aramco entities including designing, developing, installing, and troubleshooting. You will work with different disciplines such as operating sites, instrumentation engineering, facility planning, and project management. Additionally, you are expected to participate in the organization and company initiatives including safety programs, innovation programs, operational excellence, knowledge sharing, self-development and other programs as required.

Key Responsibilities:

As a successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Provide support with all types of instrumentation including but not limited level, temperature, pressure, control valves, Emergency Isolation Valves, Motor Operated Valve, Relief Valves, flow measurement, level gauges etc.
  • Originate and carries out engineering studies to determine optimal solutions to complex technical problems, increase revenue, reduce cost, and improve process safety.
  • Works with and/or leads Task teams assigned to investigate incidents or solve specific technical problems.
  • Undertakes special assignments requiring extensive technical experience and discretion when dealing with outside organizations.
  • Develops and maintains Saudi Aramco Engineering Standards, Material Specifications, Procedures and Best Practices to enhance company profitability, safety, and productivity by applying and interpreting key industry codes and standards relevant to instrumentation and control.
  • Reviews and evaluates capabilities of vendors and contractors to determine their acceptability to perform major services to Saudi Aramco.
  • Acts as a Company representative in technical dealings with vendors, manufacturers, and design firms.
  • Perform technical evaluation for instrumentation quotations and attend technical bid evaluation meetings.
  • Evaluates and introduces best practices and new technologies to enable the Company to achieve Best in Class performance in oil and gas business.
  • Performs cost analyses and Value Engineering studies to recommend cost-effective solutions to technical issues.

Minimum Requirements:

As a successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering preferably in Instrumentation, Mechanical or Electrical engineering. A Master's degree or PhD in Engineering is desired but not required.
  • Minimum 20 years of professional experience as an engineer in charge of technical work in field of specialty. Previous work with a major international Oil & Gas Company and/or previous employment with one of the Instrumentation suppliers used by Company is desired.
  • Must have experience in plant instrumentation sizing and selection (Control valves, Pressure Relief valves, Actuators, Basic Process Measurement etc.)
  • Certified in ISA- Certified Automation Professional (CAP), Certified Functional Safety Professional (CFSP), TUV FSEng, Principles & Practice of Engineering (PE) certification, or Chartered Engineer (C.E.) license or registration.
  • Basic knowledge of H2S, LEL, pH, conductivity, O2 analyzer, CO/CO2 analyzer, fire & gas detectors and Gas chromatographs is preferred.
  • Proficiency in the International codes and standards used within the oil and gas industry, i.e., API, BS, ISO, ASME, ANSI, IEC, ISA, IEEE, etc.
  • Have participated as lead engineer in HAZOP, SIL, P&ID, Design, and model reviews.
  • Understanding of control systems, compressor and pumps field instrumentation, speed controllers, Vibration Monitoring Systems (VMS), Compressor Control Systems (CCS).
  • Understanding communication protocols like DNP3, Modbus, FieldBus, TCP, IEC, SPA, RP570, ANSI and General Process Automation Protocols.
  • Have been an active member in a relevant professional society, (i.e., ISA, IEEE, etc.) for a minimum of 3 years and have been holding current membership.

title: Senior .Net Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Software Engineer (Contractor)

Job Type: Full-time (Remote)

Pay: R$20,000.00 – R$22,000.00 per month

Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer contractor to join our U.S.-based team remotely. You will leverage your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects.

In this role, you will work on our healthcare platform, gaining deep system knowledge and contributing to our Agile workflow via Azure DevOps . You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews , expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. Your role will evolve based on your strengths and our needs — all while adhering to rigorous coding and security standards .

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Design & Development

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to design software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancing existing codebases (opportunities starting around months 3–4).

2. Testing & Quality

  • Design and implement automated End-to-End (E2E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability — with a strong focus during your first 6–9 months.

3. Peer Reviews & Post-Release Support

  • Participate in pre-release feature reviews (ongoing).
  • Conduct initial post-release bug ticket analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.

4. Agile Collaboration

  • Actively contribute to 2-week sprints and 6-week release cycles (3 sprints per release).
  • Participate in sprint planning, pull requests, releases, and daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT).

5. Communication & Coordination

  • Collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical team members across time zones.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 8 years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record on complex projects.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Application (.NET 8) for mobile and web development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure (Azure App Service, Azure SQL, Azure Storage).
  • Proficient with modern development tools (Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with healthcare software or Protected Health Information standards (e.g., HIPAA).
  • Experience with pull request reviews and sprint participation.

How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: 2-week sprints, 6-week release cycles, daily stand-ups at 3:00 PM CT.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tools: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and more.
  • Team Culture: Accountability, quality, and excellence in delivery.

Job Title: Senior Project Manager (Software Development)

Indigo Beam is a digital transformation consulting firm dedicated to helping organizations evolve their business through modern technology solutions. Project Management:

  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

  • Own and facilitate project status meetings, adjusting project targets and schedules as needed.

  • Facilitate daily stand-ups (scrums), sprint planning, and sprint retrospectives to ensure team collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Monitor and manage burndown charts and other Agile metrics to track project progress and ensure timely delivery.

  • Ensure business requirements are clearly defined, documented, and communicated to technical teams.

Client Engagement:

  • Serve as clients' primary point of contact, ensuring their needs and expectations are met.
  • Communicate project progress, risks, and issues effectively to clients and stakeholders.
  • Ensure client satisfaction by delivering projects that meet or exceed their requirements.

Technical Oversight:

  • Collaborate with Technical Architects to ensure project designs align with business objectives and technical standards.
  • Review and approve technical and business documentation, ensuring completeness and accuracy.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies to provide strategic technical direction.

Quality Assurance & Risk Management:

  • Identify and mitigate project risks, ensuring proactive solutions to potential challenges.

Required Skills & Experience:

  • Minimum of 8 years of IT Project Management experience in an Agile (Scrum) environment, with a strong focus on application/software development.
  • Prior hands-on development or coding experience.
  • Proven track record of managing teams of Technical Architects, Developers, QA professionals, and Business Analysts.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft DevOps, particularly in managing user stories, epics, sprints, and Agile metrics such as burndown charts.
  • Ability to perform business analysis on projects, including requirements gathering and process documentation.
  • Experience managing project budgets of over $1M and delivering projects on time and within scope.
  • Hands-on experience overseeing all phases of the SDLC, from requirements gathering to deployment.
  • Exceptional communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong leadership and team management skills, with a proven ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams.
  • Strong organization skills and mindset.

Desired Skills & Qualifications:

  • Previous experience in a consulting role or possessing a consultative mindset.

Other:

title: Corretor de imóveis
description:
Resumo do Cargo

O Corretor de Imóveis parceiro da Apolar Jardim Botânico é um profissional dinâmico e proativo, responsável pela comercialização de imóveis prontos (usados) e lançamentos em Curitiba e Região Metropolitana.

Como ter sucesso no cargo: O sucesso nesta função é impulsionado pela capacidade de entender e antecipar as necessidades dos clientes, oferecendo soluções imobiliárias que geram valor. Isso inclui uma gestão eficiente de leads de diversas fontes, um uso exemplar das ferramentas tecnológicas, e uma participação ativa na angariação de novos imóveis para a carteira. Profissionais que se destacam são aqueles que cultivam relações de confiança, dominam as técnicas de negociação, e mantêm-se atualizados sobre o mercado imobiliário e as condições de financiamento. A colaboração com a equipe e o alinhamento com os objetivos da franquia são diferenciais para alcançar o sucesso.

Responsabilidades
  • Angariar Imóveis: Identificar e angariar ativamente imóveis (usados e lançamentos) na região de Curitiba e Região Metropolitana, expandindo o portfólio da franquia e visando atingir a meta de 100 imóveis em carteira.
  • Gestão de Leads: Gerenciar e qualificar leads provenientes de diversas fontes (portais de anúncio, anúncios patrocinados, portal da Rede Apolar, LAIS), realizando o primeiro contato, acompanhamento e nutrição para convertê-los em clientes qualificados.
  • Uso de CRM: Determinar e desenvolver requisitos de usuários para sistemas em produção (Apolar Sales), garantindo o preenchimento completo e organizado de todas as informações de clientes, imóveis e interações, otimizando o fluxo de trabalho.
  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Realizar atendimento consultivo e personalizado, compreendendo a real necessidade do cliente, apresentando as opções de imóveis mais adequadas e conduzindo visitas de forma eficaz.
  • Negociação e Fechamento: Conduzir processos de negociação de compra e venda, elaboração de propostas e acompanhamento de contratos, garantindo a segurança e transparência em todas as etapas da transação.
  • Colaboração com a Equipe: Colaborar ativamente com a equipe de corretores, gerência e franqueados parceiros, compartilhando informações de mercado, estratégias e melhores práticas para otimização dos resultados coletivos.
  • Avaliação de Imóveis: Colaborar no processo de avaliação de imóveis quando solicitado, utilizando o conhecimento de mercado e, se certificado, o registro no CNAI.
  • Conhecimento de Mercado: Manter-se atualizado/a sobre as tendências do mercado imobiliário de Curitiba, novas legislações, condições de financiamento e o perfil de cada bairro para oferecer um serviço consultivo de excelência.
Qualificações
  • Formação: Ensino Médio completo. Curso superior, é um diferencial, mas não obrigatório.
  • Registro Profissional: Possuir registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Corretores de Imóveis (CRECI).
  • Experiência: Experiência prévia comprovada na comercialização de imóveis, com preferência para atuação em imóveis usados e/ou lançamentos.
  • Competências de Comunicação: Excelentes competências de comunicação oral e escrita, com clareza, persuasão e habilidade para se comunicar por telefone e WhatsApp.
  • Habilidade Tecnológica: Familiaridade e disposição para utilizar ferramentas de CRM (Apolar Sales) e outras tecnologias para gestão de leads, acompanhamento de processos e organização de informações.
  • Proatividade e Resiliência: Capacidade de agir com proatividade na busca por resultados e na angariação de imóveis, além de resiliência para lidar com objeções e desafios do mercado.
  • Orientação para o Cliente: Forte orientação para o cliente, com foco em entender suas necessidades, construir relacionamentos de confiança e proporcionar uma experiência de compra positiva.
  • Organização: Boa capacidade de organização e atenção aos detalhes para manter registros precisos e acompanhar múltiplos processos simultaneamente.
  • Infraestrutura: Possuir carro, notebook, acesso à internet fora do escritório e celular para desempenho das atividades.

Para se candidatar entrar em contato através do e-mail: ou através do celular (WhatsApp) .

  • Documentar as etapas do desenvolvimento utilizando ferramentas de versionamento e documentação técnica.
  • Participar ativamente de discussões técnicas e funcionais, contribuindo com ideias e propondo soluções junto ao time.
  • Garantir a qualidade do software por meio da adoção de boas práticas, revisão de código e uso eficiente de ferramentas.
  • Detalhar requisitos junto a clientes e áreas envolvidas, transformando necessidades de negócio em especificações técnicas.
  • Utilizar frameworks e padrões definidos pela arquitetura da empresa.
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento, analistas de negócios e outras áreas para definição de requisitos e soluções.
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas para alinhamento de entregas. junto ao time e cliente.

  • JPA, Hibernate
  • Experiência em Oracle e/ou SQL Server
  • AngularJS
  • RESTful
  • SOLID
  • SOAP

DIFERENCIAL:

  • Kafka
  • Keycloak
  • GIT
  • Métodos Ágeis

title: Strategic Sourcing Specialist
description:
About the role:

Are you ready to play a key role in shaping sourcing strategies for one of the world’s leading financial institutions?

We’re looking for a driven, client-focused Sourcer to join our dynamic team in São Paulo, delivering high-impact procurement solutions for a large global banking client. This role offers a unique opportunity to manage strategic sourcing projects across Latin and South America—helping our client achieve measurable value, resilience, and innovation in their supply base.

As part of our global Sourcing team, you’ll lead end-to-end procurement initiatives across Professional Services, Technology Services, Real Estate, and Facilities Management, working alongside experts across multiple geographies.

Main responsibilities will include:

  • Lead sourcing initiatives across key categories such as Professional Services (consulting, HR, legal, insurance, translation), Technology Services, and Corporate Services (Real Estate, Facilities).
  • Manage complete tendering processes (RFPs, RFIs) and supplier evaluations to identify best-value providers.
  • Develop robust negotiation strategies based on cost analytics, market insights, and client objectives.
  • Partner closely with internal stakeholders and suppliers to build long-term, collaborative relationships across the Americas and globally.
  • Draft, review, and negotiate contracts—including Master Agreements, Statements of Work, and SLAs—with minimal legal support.
  • Ensure alignment with client governance, regulatory frameworks, and sourcing policies.
  • Track and report savings, value creation, and project milestones using Chain IQ and client systems.
  • Collaborate globally to leverage synergies, share best practices, and continuously enhance procurement performance.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in Supply Chain, Business, or related field; MBA a plus.
  • 3+ years of sourcing or procurement experience—ideally covering Professional Services, Technology, and Corporate categories.
  • Strong negotiation and contract management skills with limited legal oversight.
  • Proven experience running large-scale sourcing projects and managing regional supplier networks.
  • Fluency in Portuguese, Spanish, and English is essential.
  • Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills for analytical reporting and executive presentations.
  • Strategic thinker with excellent communication and influencing skills.
  • Familiarity with the Brazilian regulatory and procurement environment highly desirable.

What we offer:

  • The opportunity to partner with a major global bank, managing high-visibility projects that drive meaningful business impact.
  • A diverse, international work environment that values collaboration and innovation.
  • Continuous learning and global career growth through collaboration with colleagues across Europe, the Americas, and APAC.
  • A culture that rewards creativity, impact, and teamwork.
  • If you’re passionate about procurement excellence and want to contribute to a high-performing organization supporting one of the world’s top financial institutions, we’d love to hear from you.

title: MSP Delivery Specialist (Bilingual English | Portuguese)
description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a trusted leader in workforce solutions and managed service provider (MSP) operations. We partner with enterprise clients to streamline contingent workforce management, strengthen supplier relationships, and ensure program compliance. Our mission is to deliver operational excellence through technology-driven solutions, industry expertise, and exceptional service quality across all facets of workforce delivery.

Summary

Pinnacle Group is seeking an MSP Delivery Specialist to manage the full life cycle of contingent workforce requests. This role serves as a key point of contact for client hiring managers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders, ensuring seamless requisition management, compliance, and operational success. The ideal candidate has strong experience in recruitment, MSP operations, and Vendor Management Systems (VMS), combined with a customer service mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

Job Description

  • Train, assist, and facilitate the requisition life cycle with client hiring managers and suppliers.
  • Support large-scale hiring initiatives, VMS data integrity projects, and supplier rationalization efforts.
  • Conduct intake calls, qualify candidate resumes, and manage requisition flow from posting through fulfillment.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with hiring managers, suppliers, and internal program teams to ensure program success.
  • Maintain a service-focused approach, delivering a high-quality experience to all stakeholders.
  • Utilize and provide training on MSP tool such as Beeline and applications including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Ensure timely and accurate submission of required documentation by suppliers, maintaining adherence to SLAs and KPIs.
  • Support reporting, analytics, and client-specific initiatives as assigned.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience, preferably in a business-related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in MSP operations, or contingent workforce management .
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and experience with Beeline
  • Bilingual Competency across English and Portuguese
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts clearly.
  • Proven success in a client-facing, fast-paced, and service-oriented environment.
  • Self-starter who can work independently and exercise sound judgment in ambiguous situations.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities with a solution-driven mindset.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy under tight deadlines.

Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you’ll play a vital role in advancing workforce solutions that power some of the world’s leading organizations. We foster a collaborative environment that encourages innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth. You’ll have the opportunity to strengthen your MSP expertise, build strategic relationships, and make a meaningful impact in a company that values excellence and accountability.

Compensation and Benefits Disclosure

The specific compensation for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role as well as the cost of labor in the market; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. Our full-time consultants have access to benefits including medical, dental, vision and 401K contributions as well as any other PTO, sick leave, and other benefits mandated by appliable state or localities where you reside or work.

title: Aprendiz Assistente Administrativo (Exclusivo para PCD)
description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos gente que cuida de gente. Cada um com características, histórias e qualidades únicas, mas todos unidos pelo mesmo propósito: viver plenamente. Temos orgulho da nossa história, por isso fazemos o nosso melhor hoje, sem deixar de olhar para o amanhã.

Se você preza pela valorização humana, integridade, foco no cliente, superação de resultados, sustentabilidade, inovação em soluções em tudo o que faz, vem fazer parte do nosso time de gigantes.

Como é o ambiente de trabalho?

Oferecemos um ambiente em que todos são protagonistas e agentes de transformação. Temos um excelente clima organizacional com pessoas engajadas em entregar os melhores resultados, assim como grandes oportunidades de crescimento para você.

Vem conferir!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Apoiar nas rotinas administrativas do setor, garantindo a organização e o fluxo de informações;
  • Digitalizar, organizar e arquivar documentos de forma eficiente;
  • Auxiliar na criação, atualização e manutenção de planilhas para controle de dados;
  • Contribuir com a organização e manutenção de arquivos físicos e digitais;
  • Realizar envio e acompanhamento de e-mails, além de interagir com outras áreas, sempre que necessário;
  • Prestar suporte ao gestor e à equipe em atividades administrativas e operacionais;
  • Participar de reuniões e treinamentos para desenvolvimento profissional;
  • Apoiar na elaboração de relatórios simples e no acompanhamento de indicadores do setor, quando solicitado.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Médio completo ou Ensino Superior em andamento;
  • Sem limite de idade para participação;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no Centro de Fortaleza;
  • Carga horária de 6 horas diárias, com jornada de trabalho das 8h às 14h ou das 12h às 18h;
  • Atuação de 4 dias na empresa e 1 dias em curso no SENAC;
  • Necessário apresentar laudo médico comprovando a condição de pessoa com deficiência (PcD), válido e de acordo com os critérios legais.

Informações adicionais

BENEFÍCIOS :

  • Vale transporte;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Up Farma – Universidade Corporativa Pague Menos com cursos e treinamentos para o desenvolvimento do colaborador;
  • Sempre Bem Ouro+ (acesso gratuito à telemedicina, psicólogo e nutricionista);
  • Desconto Ouro nas Farmácias Pague Menos.

Não fazemos distinção de cor, religião, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade.

Etapas do processo

Etapa 1: Cadastro

Etapa 2: Entrevista RH

Etapa 3: Entrevista Gestor

Etapa 4: Carta Proposta

Etapa 5: Contratação

VEM SER GIGANTE, VEM TRABALHAR NA REDE DE FARMÁCIAS QUE É DO TAMANHO DO BRASIL

Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma , saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza!

Nossa história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE e por meio da valorização humana , da superação de resultados , do foco no cliente , da sustentabilidade , da integridade e da inovação em soluções nos tornamos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil.

Nosso modelo de negócios é baseado na venda de produtos e serviços voltados para a saúde e bem-estar dos nossos clientes. Atuamos no mercado de varejo de especialidade, seguindo o conceito de drugstore . Buscamos ser não somente uma rede de farmácias, mas um hub integrado de saúde . Desta forma, implementamos, a partir de 2016, o Clinic Farma, consultório farmacêutico o qual nossos clientes recebem, em salas equipadas e confortáveis, acompanhamento individualizado em seus tratamentos.

Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente .

Se você tem amor por servir e é gente que cuida de gente, vem ser Gigante! Aqui, quem acredita e trabalha cresce.

title: MBRAS Partner - Consultor Imobiliário de Alto Padrão
description:
Consultor Imobiliário de Alto Padrão (Programa PARTNERS MBRAS)

Localização: São Paulo, Capital

Sobre a MBRAS

A MBRAS é líder no mercado imobiliário de altíssimo padrão em São Paulo desde 2010. Reconhecida por sua inovação e excelência, a empresa oferece experiências imobiliárias exclusivas, consultoria especializada e gestão de ativos para uma clientela selecionada.

Sobre o Programa MBRAS Partners

Estamos lançando o MBRAS Partners , uma iniciativa que proporciona a profissionais experientes a oportunidade de ingressar ou evoluir no mercado imobiliário de luxo atuando em parceria com a marca líder MBRAS. Buscamos empreendedores, diretores, engenheiros, advogados, vendedores do mercado de luxo, dentre outras profissões que desejam atuar como nossos Consultores Associados neste segmento promissor, aproveitando toda estrutura e prestígio da marca MBRAS.

Responsabilidades

• Gerenciar e desenvolver uma carteira de imóveis de alto padrão.

• Prestar consultoria especializada aos clientes, entendendo suas necessidades e oferecendo soluções personalizadas.

• Conduzir negociações e fechar transações com alto nível de profissionalismo.

• Utilizar sistemas avançados de gestão de ativos e clientes para otimizar processos.

• Colaborar com a equipe de marketing para promover imóveis através de materiais visuais de alta qualidade.

• Participar de treinamentos e programas de desenvolvimento profissional oferecidos pela Universidade MBRAS.

Requisitos

• Experiência comprovada em áreas como vendas, engenharia, direito, arquitetura, comunicação, gestão ou afins.

  • Interesse em transicionar carreira para a àrea imobiliária.

• Perfil empreendedor com desejo de crescimento no mercado imobiliário de luxo.

• Excelente habilidade de comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal.

• Alto nível de ética e profissionalismo.

• Interesse em educação contínua e desenvolvimento profissional.

  • Residir em São Paulo capital.
  • Não ter experiência como corretor de imóveis.

O que oferecemos:

Infraestrutura de Alto Padrão

title: Broadcast Specialist/Coordinator
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.

About the position:

We are looking for a Broadcast Specialist/Coordinator who will be responsible for leading the planning, execution, and optimization of all broadcast and content initiatives within Free Fire Esports. This role combines production, storytelling, and digital strategy expertise to deliver world-class esports broadcasts and high-impact content that enhance the fan experience. The Broadcast & Content Specialist/Coordinator acts as a bridge between internal teams, external vendors, influencers, and regional stakeholders to ensure creative alignment, operational excellence, and consistent brand storytelling across all tournaments and platforms.

Make sure to share your CV in English.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the full broadcast and content pipeline for Free Fire Esports — from pre-production planning to live execution and post-event content delivery.
  • Manage relationships with broadcast vendors, studios, and creative agencies, ensuring adherence to Garena’s quality standards, deadlines, and budget.
  • Supervise on-site production during tournaments, overseeing show flow, run-down execution, and coordination between technical, talent, and content teams.
  • Drive the creative direction of tournament broadcasts, including narrative development, talent integration, segment design, and audience interaction.
  • Collaborate closely with Marketing and Social Media teams to align content distribution plans, ensuring maximum reach and engagement across all digital channels.
  • Oversee the development of post-production deliverables (recaps, highlights, interviews, documentaries, etc.), ensuring consistency in tone, pacing, and storytelling.
  • Analyze viewership and engagement data to inform future broadcast and content strategies, identifying performance trends and improvement opportunities.
  • Support marketing teams with guidelines and toolkits to ensure global consistency of broadcast quality and messaging.
  • Manage the internal review process for scripts, visual assets, and show rundowns, ensuring narrative cohesion and compliance with brand standards.
  • Stay ahead of emerging broadcast technologies, formats, and fan engagement tools to continuously evolve Free Fire Esports’ viewing experience.

Main job requirements:

  • Education: Completed higher education. Desirable in Communication, Broadcasting, Media Production, or related fields.

title: Cybersecurity Manager | Risk Management (GRC)
description:

Imagine your future. Care for your career. Simplify your journey.

Isso significa que você terá a chance de construir soluções de impacto, crescer com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento e evoluir em uma cultura que valoriza bem-estar, inclusão e clareza.

Combinamos flexibilidade, autonomia e colaboração global — para que você possa focar no que importa, se conectar com propósito e ajudar a moldar o futuro.

Aqui, você vai encontrar espaço para crescer, oportunidades reais para liderar e uma cultura onde todas as pessoas pertencem e contribuem.

✨ Se você quer fazer parte da próxima geração de soluções financeiras, este é o lugar certo.

Já te imagina sendo Nxter?

O que você vai fazer

Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Cybersegurança para liderar a função de Gestão de Riscos de Cybersegurança dentro de um time de GRC , atuando de forma transversal em múltiplas plataformas, entidades e geografias.

Este(a) profissional será responsável por garantir uma abordagem preventiva (Shift Left) de segurança, integrando práticas de SSDLC , administração de testes de penetração , avaliação contínua de riscos e governança de controles de segurança ao longo de todas as esteiras de desenvolvimento e operação.

Gestão de Riscos de Cybersegurança

  • Liderar o processo corporativo de identificação, análise, avaliação, tratamento e monitoramento de riscos de cybersegurança .
  • Manter e evoluir o risk register de cybersegurança para múltiplas entidades e plataformas.
  • Realizar análises de risco para novos produtos, arquiteturas, integrações e mudanças relevantes (Change Management).
  • Definir e acompanhar planos de mitigação, aceitação, transferência ou eliminação de riscos.
  • Apoiar decisões executivas por meio de relatórios de risco claros e orientados ao negócio.

Administração de Testes de Penetração

  • Planejar, coordenar e administrar testes de penetração (internos, externos, aplicações web/mobile, APIs, cloud e infraestrutura) .
  • Gerenciar fornecedores especializados e/ou equipes internas de pentest.
  • Garantir a correta priorização, acompanhamento e validação da correção de vulnerabilidades identificadas.
  • Integrar resultados de pentests ao processo formal de gestão de riscos.

Atuação Preventiva – Shift Left e SSDLC

  • Liderar a implementação e governança do SSDLC (Secure Software Development Life Cycle) em todas as esteiras de desenvolvimento.
  • Integrar práticas de segurança desde as fases iniciais de:
  • Requisitos e desenho de arquitetura
  • Desenvolvimento e revisão de código
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Definir e acompanhar controles como:
  • SAST, DAST, SCA, IaC Scanning e Code Review seguro
  • Atuar de forma consultiva junto a times de desenvolvimento, arquitetura e produto, promovendo segurança por design .

Governança, Conformidade e Integração com GRC

  • Garantir alinhamento com frameworks e normas como ISO 27001/27005, NIST CSF, NIST RMF, OWASP, CIS Controls , entre outros.
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas relacionadas a cybersegurança.
  • Contribuir para políticas, padrões, normas e procedimentos de segurança da informação.
  • Trabalhar de forma integrada com as frentes de Compliance, Privacidade e Continuidade de Negócios .

Gestão e Liderança

  • Liderar e desenvolver o time de Risk dentro de GRC.
  • Atuar de forma transversal com áreas de Tecnologia, Produto, Engenharia, Cloud, Jurídico e Negócio.
  • Promover cultura de segurança e conscientização em cybersegurança nas diferentes geografias.
  • Gerenciar prioridades em um ambiente complexo e multicultural.

✅ O que buscamos em você

  • Experiência sólida em gestão de riscos de cybersegurança .
  • Conhecimento prático em testes de penetração e gestão de vulnerabilidades.
  • Experiência comprovada em SSDLC e práticas Shift Left .
  • Forte entendimento de arquiteturas modernas (cloud, microserviços, APIs, DevOps).
  • Experiência em ambientes multiplataforma, multi-entidade e multi-geografia .
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de segurança de aplicações e pipelines CI/CD.
  • Experiência sólida em cargos de liderança ou gestão em Cybersegurança.
  • Capacidade de traduzir riscos técnicos em impacto de negócio.
  • Perfil analítico, estruturado e orientado a processos.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de negociação com stakeholders técnicos e executivos.
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma estratégica e operacional.
  • Inglês avançado.

✅ O que pode contar pontos a mais

  • Certificações como CISM, CRISC, CISSP, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, CEH .
  • Experiência em organizações globais ou ambientes regulados.
  • Vivência com modelos de maturidade de segurança e risk-based security.
  • Espanhol é um diferencial.

O que oferecemos

title: Software Engineer
description:
About Us

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.

We’re building the infrastructure that powers smarter agency discovery, matchmaking, and evaluation—and we’re looking for a developer who wants real ownership over how that system is built and evolves.

⸻

The Role

As Vendry’s Developer, you’ll be responsible for building, maintaining, and evolving the core technical infrastructure that powers the Vendry platform. This is a hands-on role with broad ownership across frontend, backend, and internal tooling.

You’ll manage everything from our public-facing website and landing pages to our agency portal and proprietary agency search engine. You’ll work closely with the founding team to ship features quickly, improve performance and reliability, and help shape the technical direction of the product.

This is an ideal role for a developer who thrives in early-stage environments, enjoys autonomy, and is excited to build and iterate fast.

⸻

Responsibilities

• Own and manage Vendry’s full technical stack, including:

• Frontend website and marketing landing pages

• Agency portal and internal tools

• Proprietary agency search and matchmaking engine

• Build, ship, and maintain new features across the product with a focus on speed, quality, and scalability.

• Ensure the platform is reliable, performant, and secure as usage grows.

• Collaborate closely with product, operations, and leadership to translate business needs into technical solutions.

• Stay up to date on modern development trends, tools, and best practices.

• Leverage AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) to improve velocity and code quality.

• Troubleshoot issues across the stack and proactively improve system architecture.

• Document technical decisions and maintain clean, readable codebases.

⸻

Qualifications

• 3+ years of experience as a software developer or engineer.

• Experience working in a startup environment is a must.

• Strong experience with modern frontend and backend development.

• Comfortable owning projects end-to-end, from idea to production.

• Familiarity with databases, APIs, and search or filtering systems is a plus.

• Experience building or maintaining SaaS products or internal platforms is strongly preferred.

• Curious, self-motivated, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

• Strong problem-solving skills and clear written communication.

⸻

Compensation

• Salary: $2,000–$4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and scope.

• Full-time, remote role.

⸻

Why Join Vendry

Joining Vendry means having real ownership over a product that’s redefining how brands find agency partners. You won’t be maintaining a tiny slice of a massive codebase—you’ll be shaping the foundation of a growing platform.

  • We’re a small, fast-moving team that values initiative, clarity of thinking, and building practical solutions that actually get used. If you enjoy shipping, iterating, and seeing your work directly impact the business, you’ll feel right at home.

Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. You will be responsible for the entire development lifecycle. In our team, everyone has the opportunity to share ideas, bring new solutions, and discuss them with other well-experienced engineers.

  • Identify areas for improvement in the codebase and take ownership of small-to-medium-sized systems, such as fixing bugs and optimizing performance.
  • Quickly understand documentation and utilize testing techniques, such as unit testing, integration testing, and stress testing, to ensure high-quality code.

  • Align work with customer value by using feedback to prioritize features.
  • Balance priorities and seek guidance when needed to make informed decisions.

  • Experience working with systems at scale utilizing microservices, AWS services
  • Interest in learning or exposure to event-based architecture
  • Team player mentality: high collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings
  • A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases.
  • A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects.

Nice to have:

title: Finance Manager (Brazil)
description:
The Finance Manager will oversee all financial, accounting, and tax functions for the Brazilian entity, ensuring compliance with local statutory requirements, tax regulations, and corporate reporting standards. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical accounting expertise, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to excel in a fast-paced start-up environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the maintenance of accurate financial reports and accounting records in line with corporate guidelines, corporate timelines and local statutory requirements.
  • Manage the full spectrum of the accounting functions, including accounts payables, accounts receivables, balance sheet schedules, general ledger maintenance, and cash flow management.
  • Manage closing processes and preparation of accurate and timely financial reports and analysis of financial information.
  • Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and municipal tax obligations.
  • Manage tax incentives including PPB (Processo Produtivo Básico) and tax optimization opportunities ensuring compliance with Brazilian tax laws.
  • Coordinate and liaise with external parties (e.g. banks, external auditors, tax agents, corporate secretarial agents, local tax and government authorities) to ensure smooth operations.
  • Collaborate across departments in preparing and managing the OPEX budgets.
  • Identify and implement process improvements in internal accounting and financial operations efficiency.
  • Partner with business units to provide finance-related advice.
  • Coordinate with headquarters to align local reporting with group consolidation requirements.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in finance and tax management, including 3+ years in an international setting.
  • Knowledge of Direct and Indirect tax.
  • Advanced analytical skills and high attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to work independently, manage pressure, and meet tight deadlines.
  • Proficiency in English.
  • Prior experience in accounting firms is an added advantage.

description:
Project Description:

  • Technical QA & Testing - Validate technical tasks where standard QA teams might struggle. Test backend logic, data integrity, and complex trading scenarios (e.g., FIX message routing) before they hit production.

  • Scripting Basics - Ability to read and write scripts in Python or Bash for automation tasks.
  • QA/Engineering Mindset - You verify things thoroughly. You ask "what if?" and try to break the system before the traders do.
  • English - Upper-Intermediate (B2) or higher. Clear written and verbal communication is a must.

title: Bolsista Doutor - Akiyama - Impactos da Computação Quântica na Identificação e biometria | Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - IEL/PR
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .

Sobre a Oportunidade:

Akiyama é referência nacional no desenvolvimento de tecnologias de identificação e segurança, com soluções inovadoras que atendem a setores como segurança pública, bancos, empresas privadas e órgãos governamentais. Nosso foco é criar produtos de alto desempenho em biometria, inteligência artificial e segurança da informação, sempre impulsionando a inovação e a transformação digital.

Estamos buscando um(a) profissional altamente qualificado(a) para integrar nosso time de P&D, contribuindo no desenvolvimento de soluções que combinam computação quântica, IA e cibersegurança aplicadas à biometria.

Formação Acadêmica:

Doutorado completo nas áreas de Ciência da Computação, Engenharia Elétrica, Física Aplicada, ou áreas correlatas.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Projeto: Impactos da Computação Quântica na Identificação e biometria

Principais Atividades:

  • Propor arquiteturas híbridas (clássica + quântica) para otimização de tempo de processamento em sistemas biométricos;
  • Simular hardware quântico ou utilizar computadores quânticos reais em nuvem (IBM Quantum, D-Wave, Rigetti, entre outros);
  • Aplicar criptografia, física computacional, inteligência artificial e cibersegurança aos produtos da empresa.

Conhecimento necessário:

  • Criptografia quântica e algoritmos pós-quânticos (ex.: Lattice-based cryptography);
  • Computação quântica: modelos de computação (gate-based, annealing), uso de Qiskit ou similares, circuitos quânticos e simulação de algoritmos;
  • Machine Learning e Deep Learning aplicados à biometria;
  • Experiência com bibliotecas de IA (TensorFlow, PyTorch) e frameworks quânticos (Qiskit, Cirq, PennyLane).
  • Inglês Avançado.

Conhecimento desejável:

  • Processamento de sinais biométricos (impressões digitais, face, íris, palma da mão, voz, etc.);
  • Conhecimento em teorias de informação e codificação para proteção de templates biométricos (ex.: cancelable biometrics, fuzzy extractors).

Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial

Formato de trabalho : Híbrido

Local: Curitiba/PR

Soft Skills : Trabalho em equipe; Autonomia; Organização.

title: Pessoa Executiva de Vendas - Shopping Parque D. Pedro
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Senior Maintenance Specialist
description:
Location： Guarulhos

About the Role:

We are seeking a proactive and hands-on Senior Maintenance Specialist to be a key player in ensuring the reliability and efficiency of our warehouse operations. In this role, you will execute critical daily maintenance while contributing to equipment upgrades and continuous improvement initiatives. It’s an excellent opportunity for a technical professional eager to grow, collaborate across teams, and support our facility’s safe and stable performance.

Job Summary:

The Senior Maintenance Specialist is responsible for the daily maintenance of warehouse facilities and equipment. This role also supports new equipment implementation, on-site improvements, and basic process optimization. Working under the supervision of the Maintenance Lead, you will help execute maintenance plans, coordinate daily tasks, and facilitate cross-functional communication to ensure operations are safe, reliable, and efficient.

Key Responsibilities:

1.Daily Maintenance (Core Focus)

  • Perform routine mechanical, electrical, and facility maintenance.
  • Conduct basic troubleshooting of common equipment issues with supervisor support.
  • Execute scheduled preventive maintenance (PM) tasks and update associated work orders.
  • Ensure accuracy of CMMS data and assist in updating spare parts records.

2.New Equipment & Project Support

  • Participate in the installation, commissioning, and technical support of new equipment.
  • Assist vendors during on-site work, handling basic documentation and follow-up actions.
  • Support the execution of small improvement projects, equipment modifications, and optimization activities.

3.On-Site Improvement & Lean Support

  • Engage in 5S, SOP development, and visual management activities.
  • Provide data, information, and technical input to support continuous improvement efforts.

4.Team Collaboration & Coordination

  • Assist the supervisor in implementing weekly/monthly maintenance plans and tracking daily tasks.
  • Support internal team communication, coordination, and information sharing.
  • Collaborate effectively with other departments and external vendors as required.
  • Prepare basic maintenance reports, records, and documentation.

5.Safety & Compliance

  • Adhere to all Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) requirements in all maintenance activities.
  • Identify potential operational risks and contribute to corrective actions.

Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education: Technical degree or certification in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, Maintenance, or a related field.
  • Experience: over 5 years of experience in maintenance, facilities, or a hands-on technical role. Experience with automated equipment or project support is a strong advantage.
  • Technical Skills: Foundational mechanical/electrical knowledge and strong practical troubleshooting ability. Competency in reading basic technical drawings and manuals.
  • Professional Skills:
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional coordination skills.
  • Strong execution focus, reliability, and a proactive approach to learning.
  • Good organizational skills with clear and structured problem-solving thinking.
  • Mindset: Demonstrated growth potential and a willingness to gradually take on broader responsibilities.

We Offer:

  • A collaborative and safety-first work environment.
  • Opportunities for technical growth and skill development.
  • Involvement in meaningful projects that improve our operations.

Buscamos: Workday Recruiting and Talent Analyst

About the Role

As a key member of our Workday Application Management Support team, the Workday Recruiting and Talent Analyst will own the configuration, maintenance, and support of our Recruiting, Talent, Performance and Learning modules.

You will partner closely with HR and Talent Acquisition Teams to ensure Workday solutions align with evolving business needs, legal / regulatory requirements, and employee experience goals.

This role requires deep functional expertise in Workday configuration, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to translate HR and Recruiting requirements into scalable Workday solutions.

  • Maximize the effectiveness of Workday by configuring, maintaining, and continuously optimizing Workday Recruiting, Talent, Performance, and Learning modules.
  • Enable better talent decisions and development by supporting scalable, user-friendly solutions for career growth, goal tracking, and feedback collection.
  • Enhance the candidate and employee experience by resolving issues and queries that impact usability, accuracy, or workflow across recruiting and talent modules.
  • Drive the success of the annual performance review cycle by owning the configuration, launch, monitoring, and post-cycle review of performance processes, while identifying opportunities for process and system improvements.
  • Ensure data accuracy and process scalability by preparing, loading, and validating EIBs for mass data updates.
  • Maximize system performance and adoption by evaluating new Workday releases, identifying relevant enhancements, and recommending high-impact improvements to stakeholders.
  • Ensure system reliability and business continuity by proactively monitoring health and resolving issues across Recruiting and Talent modules.
  • Improve transparency and knowledge sharing by maintaining clear, user-friendly documentation for configurations, business processes, and system policies.
  • Accelerate continuous improvement initiatives through cross-functional collaboration with analysts, IT teams, HR, Talent Acquisition and business stakeholders, delivering enhancements that add value and reduce manual effort.
  • Safeguard data integrity and compliance by ensuring configurations align with internal governance, audit requirements, and security standards.
  • Enhance user confidence and self-service adoption by contributing to the development of end-user training materials in partnership with HR.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 4+ years of hands-on Workday configuration experience, with expertise in Recruiting, Talent, Performance and Learning modules.
  • Strong understanding of HR and Recruiting policies.
  • Experience with Workday business processes, security roles related to Recruiting, Talent, and change management.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Proficiency in EIBs and data management within Workday.
  • Strong communication skills with ability to translate technical configurations to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Detail-oriented with a commitment to data accuracy and process integrity.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver quality results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Fluent English.

Preferred:

  • Workday certification(s) in HCM, Recruiting, Talent, Performance or Learning.
  • Experience supporting Workday release cycles and testing activities.

title: Security & Low-Voltage Designer / Estimator (Remote - UTS Group)
description:
Are you a detail-driven professional with experience in security and low-voltage system design and estimating? UTS Group is expanding our technical team and we want to hear from you.

UTS Group is a leading North American security integration company serving clients across Canada and the U.S. We specialize in Access Control, CCTV, Intercom, Door Hardware, Automatic Doors, and full low-voltage infrastructure. We are looking for a Security & Low-Voltage Designer / Estimator who can review drawings, analyze tenders, design system layouts, and prepare accurate cost estimates for complex projects.

This is a remote, full-time role, working Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time (ET).

⸻

Position Overview

This hybrid role blends design and estimating. You will review construction drawings, bids, and tender packages, then translate them into complete design documents, material takeoffs, and competitive estimates. You’ll prepare layouts, risers, and technical specifications using AutoCAD and Bluebeam, while collaborating with project managers, sales teams, and vendors to ensure accuracy and compliance.

⸻

Key Responsibilities

• Review and interpret technical drawings, floor plans, door schedules, and tender documents

• Design integrated security systems (CCTV, Access Control, Intrusion, Intercom)

• Design low-voltage/data systems including structured cabling, network racks, and pathways

• Prepare material take-offs (MTO), labour estimates, and detailed cost proposals

• Produce layouts, risers, and markups using AutoCAD and Bluebeam

• Develop and submit accurate quotations and bid packages

• Collaborate with sales, PMs, and vendors to confirm pricing, timelines, and compatibility

• Maintain organized records of estimates, proposals, drawings, and documentation

• Participate in handover meetings for awarded projects

• Contribute to continuous improvement of estimating templates and design standards

⸻

Must-Have Qualifications

• 2–3+ years of experience in security system estimating or low-voltage design

• Proven ability to read and interpret construction drawings and tender documents

• Strong proficiency with AutoCAD and Bluebeam Revu

• Solid understanding of low-voltage systems, wiring methods, and structured cabling standards (TIA/EIA)

• Experience with quoting Access Control, CCTV, Intercom, Door Hardware, and related systems

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills

• Proficiency with Office 365 (Excel, Outlook, Word)

• Ability to work remotely with strong self-management and organization

• Experience with Zoho CRM/Books or similar platforms is an asset

⸻

Nice to Have

• Education in Engineering, Architecture, Technology, or related fields

• Knowledge of Canadian and U.S. security/building codes

• Experience preparing technical submittals or shop drawings

• French language proficiency

⸻

Work Details

• Location: Remote

• Type: Full-time

• Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET
